repo_metadata.description: NexusTK EPF Viewer written in Godot 4.x

observed: DAT parser extracts named members and byte offsets; EPF parser reads top/left/bottom/right, pixel and mask offsets.
DSC parser preserves per-part palette/base-frame/frame-count, animation ID, frame offsets and unknown bytes.
DNA parser preserves base frame, animation frame offsets, duration, alpha and unknown fields.
Motion.tbl parser reads 21-byte MotionStandard/name fields, motion ID, frame count and up to 30 per-frame layer IDs until -1.
NTK_CharacterRenderer uses motion-frame layer order, per-part animation frame offsets and shared pivot; contains TODO concerning chunkNumber/animation dictionary.

EfxTbl parser decodes effect index and frame index/delay/palette/unknown; FRM maps frame index to palette. NTK_EffectRenderer uses FRM palette lookup while Efx palette metadata is also retained. This difference needs observation, not an assumed correction.
PAL parser distinguishes DLPalette header versus multi-palette container and reads animated palette index ranges.

ViewerResources lists Nexus UI candidates DLGLOGIN, DLGNEW, iteminv/invenbut and palettes; some other mappings are explicitly Not sure. These filenames are leads for matching Korean archive members, not proof of Korean UI ownership.
limitations: All code is NexusTK-oriented reimplementation, not original Korean source. Numeric IDs have not been mapped to Korean spell/item/motion names.
DSC unknown fields do not supply confirmed player frame timing or hit frame; DNA duration/effect delay units need matching target version validation.
No sound decoder, sound ID → resource mapping or gameplay audio event call was established in inspected tool code.
Viewer palette cycling uses a user speed slider (EPFViewer.gd:164); visual preview speed is not original palette-cycle timing.
Character composition TODO and palette-source differences require P2 bounds/order/unknown-ID tests.
Godot 4.7 Forward Plus config and database/addon need explicit P2 compatibility review.
reuse: Best static candidate for exact motion layer and frame metadata extraction; MIT code license recorded.
Candidate preview renderer and named UI asset/palette crosswalk, conditional on region/version identification.
